title: Uncle Sam Gets Heavy In Brazil
text:
Uncle Sam Gets Heavy In Brazil

Tom Miller

Gavekal Research | 19 Oct 2026

With Flávio Bolsonaro narrowly leading in the polls ahead of Sunday’s presidential election run-off, there is a good chance that Brazil will follow other right-leaning Latin American nations into the United States’ political orbit. Washington would warmly welcome Brazil for several strategic reasons, not least in anticipation of gaining preferential access to its treasure trove of critical minerals.Brazil is the leading producer of “heavy” rare earths outside Asia, and the US is targeting its mines in the hope of breaking China’s chokehold. A Bolsonaro presidency is not, in fact, a deciding factor: US critical minerals investment in Brazil is already surging under President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. What does matter is that the US is finally getting its hands on a China-free supply of the magic ingredient in advanced technologies.
